newsitem.title: UK: Brown to face UK Parliament committee on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brown to face UK Parliament committee on Tuesday.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown and Chief Secretary to the Treasury Alistair Darling will give evidence on budgetary and monetary issues to parliament's Treasury Committee next Tuesday.
The Committee announced the witness timetable late on Thursday, following its first meeting since the May 1 general election.

The first session will be on Monday at 1430 GMT when it will quiz four expert witnesses -- Roger Bootle of HSBC Markets, Gavin Davies of Goldman Sachs, Bill Martin of UBS and Martin Weale of the National Institute of Economic and Social Research.
Brown's session before the committee on Tuesday will begin at 0930 GMT and Darling's at 1115 GMT.
Bank of England Governor Eddie George will give evidence on Wednesday at 1515 GMT.
As expected, the committee has chosen Labour MP Giles Radice, who is chairman of the European Movement, as its chairman.
